title: TAP Workflow Record
description: One JSON Lines record per workflow (.xaml or coded .cs file) per analysis run, written to workflow.jsonl. Captures workflow-level metadata not present in individual activity records: imported namespaces, assembly references, trigger configuration, workflow arguments, and XML prefix declarations.

schemaVersion.description: Semver version of this schema. Additive changes increment minor. Breaking changes increment major.

runId.description: Unique run identifier shared by all records in the same analysis run. Matches run-meta.json runId.

capturedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this record was written.

threadId.description: Managed thread ID of the thread that executed this rule invocation.

projectFilePath.description: Absolute path to project.json. Primary reference point for workflowRelativePath.

workflowRelativePath.description: Path of this workflow file relative to the project.json directory, using forward slashes (e.g. Workflows/Module.xaml).

isCodedWorkflow.description: True for coded workflows (.cs source files exposed via ICodeSourceFileModel). False for XAML workflows.

rootDisplayName.description: DisplayName of the root activity (IWorkflowModel.Root.DisplayName). Null for coded workflows.

rootAnnotationText.description: Full annotation text on the root activity. Carries workflow-level annotations such as @module, @pipeline, @unit. Multi-line; embedded newlines preserved. Null when no annotation exists or for coded workflows.

rootStructuralKind.description: Structural kind of the root activity. Determines the top-level container type of this workflow.

arguments.description: Arguments declared at the workflow level (IWorkflowModel.Arguments / x:Members in XAML). The canonical source for workflow-level argument contracts.

name.description: Argument name as declared (e.g. in_Config, out_Status).

type.description: CLR type name. Null when unresolved.

importedNamespaces.description: CLR namespaces imported in this workflow file (TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation). Determines which type names VB/C# expressions can use without full qualification.

assemblies.description: Assembly references declared in this workflow file (TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation).

files.description: Resolved assembly file names from IDependency.Assemblies. Null when not resolvable.

xmlPrefixes.description: XML namespace prefix declarations used in this workflow file (xmlns: attributes on the root element). Each entry maps a prefix to its namespace URI. Required for XAML generation targeting this specific file.

prefix.description: The xmlns prefix (e.g. ui, cfg, sap). Null for the default namespace (xmlns= without prefix).

namespace.description: The XML namespace URI bound to this prefix.

triggerModel.description: Trigger configuration for this workflow. Null when no trigger is configured (most workflows).

hasAny.description: True when at least one trigger type is configured. Equivalent to ITriggerModel.HasAny().

hasLocal.description: True when a local trigger (time, file, queue) is configured.

hasStart.description: True when a start trigger (robot launch) is configured.

hasIntegration.description: True when an integration trigger (API, webhook) is configured.

sourceCode.description: Full source code text for coded workflows (ICodeSourceFileModel.SourceCode). Null for XAML workflows. No truncation applied.

sourceFilePath.description: Absolute path of the coded workflow source file (ICodeSourceFileModel.FilePath). Null for XAML workflows.

_errors.description: Structured records of any field-level capture failures during this record's production.

field.description: Name of the field that failed.
